description: Customisable settings for the caterer-ui app

name.description: Name of the application. Used in the browser page title when no short name is set

short_name.description: Short name for the application. Used in browser page titles and as the app identifier

logo.description: Logo to display when the app is using the light theme

logo_dark.description: Logo to display when the app is using the dark theme

general.description: General settings associated with the app

use_region.description: Whether the level filter should list levels for the whole active region instead of only the active building, showing the parent building name under each level

chat.description: Settings for the global chat widget

enabled.description: Whether to show the global chat widget in the app

type.description: Type of icon to render. Either `img` or `icon`

src.description: URL of the image icon to display

class.description: CSS class to apply to icon container element

content.description: Content to add to the icon container element
